newsitem.title: INDIA: Stormy weather seen as cyclone passes near Bombay.
newsitem.headline: Stormy weather seen as cyclone passes near Bombay.

text.p: Storms and thundershowers will lash India's commercial capital during the next 24 hours as a cyclone passes by, weather bureau officials said on Thursday.
The cyclone, now about 250 km off the coast in a south-southwest direction, is expected to hit the neighbouring state of Gujarat late tonight, the officials said.
"The cyclone is travelling in a northerly direction and is expected to hit the coast between Dahanu and Veraval in the night," a weather bureau official told Reuters.
There was rainfall and squalls in Panjim, the capital of the neighbouring southern state of Goa, on Wednesday, as the cyclone travelled along the coast, eyewitnesses said.
"The sea was choppy, very choppy," said a manager at a large resort hotel on the coast. "There were big waves, quite high. There was wind and heavy rain. But there were no major problems."
